cases.why: Neuter, and the -ο → -α plural. This is the case that forced the shared adapter to read gender from the markup: the rendered line is `βιβλίο • (vivlío) n (plural βιβλία)`, and a rule keyed to the token after the headword finds the transliteration instead.

==Greek==
===Etymology===
From {{inh|el|grc|βιβλίον}}, from {{m|grc|βυβλίον}}, from {{m|grc|βύβλος||papyrus}}, from the city of {{m|grc|Βύβλος||Byblos}}, from {{der|el|phn|-}}.

Compare {{cog|grk-mar|вивли́о}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|el|/viˈvli.o/}}
* {{hyphenation|el|βι|βλί|ο}}

===Noun===
{{el-noun|n|βιβλία}}

# [[book]]
